description: Shows the note names of up to four voltages, or the name of the chord they spell, 8HP. Placed immediately to the right of ChordKey or CVPad it reads that module directly and needs no cables

params.text: Names each voltage as a note, or names the four together as a chord

inputs.text: A voltage to be named, read at 1V per octave

outputs.text: Passes on the voltage shown on that row, and gives 0V when nothing is feeding it

notes: as an expander it reads ChordKey or CVPad only while its panel touches the right edge of that module, with no gap between them
where a ChordKey expander is also in use, this module goes to the right of that expander
menu: Allow poly in 1 to override — fills all four displays from the channels of a polyphonic cable patched to input 1
Sharp (unchecked is flat) — picks whether the note names are spelled with sharps or with flats
Portable sequence — holds Copy chord and Copy chord as sequence, which put the displayed notes on the clipboard as a chord or as a run of four steps

inputs.1: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
inputs.2: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
inputs.3: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
